installCommand: node -e "delete process.env.npm_config_cache_dir; const cp = require('child_process'); process.exit(cp.spawnSync('npm', ['install', '--legacy-peer-deps'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }).status || 0);"
buildCommand: node -e "delete process.env.npm_config_cache_dir; const cp = require('child_process'); process.exit(cp.spawnSync('npm', ['run', 'build'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }).status || 0);"
